summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a purchase and sale agreement to acquire The Landing Alexandria, a senior housing community, from affiliates of Silverstone Senior Living for $130.0 million, subject to customary adjustments. The registrant, as acquirer, expects to operate the property as a SHOP asset and enter into a management agreement with Greystone Communities. Closing is expected on or about June 1, 2026, subject to conditions. No deal terms (price per share, premium, break fee) are applicable as this is an asset purchase. Watch for regulatory closing conditions.
